assertion_tested: Exact two-flavour chiral vacuum determinant and invariant baryon operators give a vanishing leading Dashen theta curvature, the specified e2 susceptibility logarithm, and the specified common nucleon e2 M loop; independent baryon isoscalar constant survives in individual proton response

conventions.mass_inputs: Renormalized full QCD+QED MSbar quark masses at fixed mu_q=2 GeV; derivative taken holding them fixed. No free-quark pole mass is assumed.
conventions.chiral_parameters: F,B,Z at alpha=0, fixed strange mass; SU(2) positive light masses, theta near zero; e2=4pi alpha
conventions.subtraction: Chiral scalar determinant finite term -1/2, matched to source eq(35); subtraction changes produce analytic local shifts only
conventions.susceptibility: d2 E(theta)/dtheta2 at theta=0 in zero-temperature infinite flat volume
conventions.nucleon_mass: Infinite-volume rest threshold; HB chiral expansion order p3, first order in e2 for response
conventions.charges: Qquark=diag(2/3,-1/3); Qnucleon=diag(1,0), with e factored out in script

source_formula_inputs.hep-ph/9903375v1:eq2.28-29: Lem=F2 sum_i f_i Nbar O_i N; O1=tr(Qtilde+2-Qtilde-2), O2=tr(Q+)Qtilde+, O3=tr(Qtilde+2+Qtilde-2)
